The '''Vanguard pickets''' were needle-nosed [[Starship/Legends|ships]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Belderone]] in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The pickets screened the Separatist fleet from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fire.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />
